requiredFactors.label: Availability not constrained by Varroa mites
Availability not constrained by other pests and parasites

limitations: Uses USDA NASS Honey Bee Colonies text report at execution time.
State-level public aggregate data cannot establish colony-level causality.
Stressors are not mutually exclusive; a colony may be affected by multiple stressors during a quarter.
Other States and United States aggregate rows are excluded from the primary transition panel.
No IMI-7 terminal lock is assigned from this aggregate report.
nextValidationStep: Compare current NASS release result against prior agricultural colony backfill and repeat on next annual release.
